behaviors.behavior: AC1: Step 5-int-arch runs always right after Step 5-int, authors architecture_brief.md first, spawns a separate architecture-internal-reviewer agent over brief+spec, and reuses the already-resolved plan_review tier (no second resolve_model_tier.py call)

AC2: plan.md gains a ## Internal Architecture Review section (Ran: yes|no), a retry replaces it in place, every finding is triaged fix/disclose/decline with a reason, and every finding is logged to decision_log.md under 'Internal Architecture Review — {split_name}'

AC3: the iterate side runs the same pass as a new step immediately after the Internal Plan Review sub-step, gated at medium+ only, writes the brief + a spec section, and notes the outcome in the iterate ADR (never decision_log.md directly). A resume must reconcile a still-pending architecture_internal row BEFORE the early 'already ran' skip, never after
AC4: Step 5a (plan) and step 2a (iterate) read the already-authored brief instead of re-writing it; the CLI's existing --plan-file refusal is untouched

AC5: record_review_pass.py accepts --review-type architecture_internal (added to REVIEW_TYPES/OPTIONAL_PRESENCE_TYPES, metadata-only, no --from adapter), and the plan_review model-tier floor verifier judges it the same way it judges plan_internal
behaviors.evidence: shared/tests/test_review_record.py::test_new_record_materializes_every_type_as_pending (8-type REVIEW_TYPES incl. architecture_internal), ::test_a_marker_is_not_written_for_an_internal_type PASSED; shared/tests/test_record_review_pass_cli.py (architecture_internal --status not_applicable acceptance) PASSED; shared/tests/test_review_record_model_tier_floor.py::test_architecture_internal_floor_is_independent_of_review_floor, ::test_architecture_internal_below_floor_is_flagged_but_still_passes, ::test_architecture_internal_codex_transport_produces_no_floor_note PASSED

behaviors.behavior: AC6: the campaign sub-iterate-runner permanently records architecture_internal as not_run (identical wording pattern to plan_internal) so the F11 review-record gate stays green on campaign runs without activating the pass there

AC7: gate_catalog.json carries plan.architecture-internal-review-high-severity-declined as a sibling auto-default entry under single_session, reused unchanged by /shipwright-iterate's own STOP-and-ask

AC8: docs/hooks-and-pipeline.md documents the new agent, its two spawn sites, the brief-authoring order, and the model-tier floor's extended scope; the four named shared tests asserting REVIEW_TYPES cardinality/membership include architecture_internal
behaviors.evidence: shared/tests/test_review_record.py, shared/tests/test_record_review_pass_cli.py, shared/tests/test_review_record_model_tier_floor.py, shared/tests/test_campaign_review_contract_prose.py all reference architecture_internal and PASSED

behaviors.behavior: the architecture-review anchoring defense holds in code (not just prose) on the iterate side: strip_prior_review_sections() removes a prior ## Internal Plan Review / ## Internal Architecture Review / ## Self-Review section from the spec before it reaches the external architecture pass, and does NOT strip for --mode iterate

D2 fix (Stage-3 doubt review, escalated to a hard BLOCK by the F11 local PR-review preflight): the architecture-internal-reviewer agent's own Read/Grep/Glob access makes a prose-only 'ignore prior sections' instruction unenforceable on the iterate side, where the spec it is handed already carries the Internal Plan Review section. prepare_architecture_internal_spec.py writes a sanitized copy (reusing strip_prior_review_sections) and the iterate skill spawns the agent over that copy's path, never the real iterate spec. A second F11 preflight BLOCK on the same tool found --run-id joined unchecked into the output path (path traversal); fixed by requiring the iterate RUN_ID_STRICT format and verifying the resolved output directory stays under the intended runs root
